cases.json'", "aggregated_output": "### No Tracing tab\n\nThe **Tracing** tab is not available in the hosted app. It is a live log
of the JSON-RPC traffic between the Inspector and a server you are connected to, and it streams from the local Inspector process'
s RPC bus — which a hosted deployment does not run. Use the [local inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md) for the ful
l log. In the hosted app, the JSON-RPC frames for a chat turn are captured and shown with that turn in the Playground instead.\n\n
Getting eval traces OUT of the hosted app is a different thing, and it does work: open a completed run and use **Export traces** f
or an OTLP JSON file (see [Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md#exporting-traces)), or fetch the same projection from
`GET /api/v1/trace-exports/otlp` in the [public API](https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md). Both use OpenInference sem

antic conventions and land in Arize Phoenix, Datadog, or any other OTLP-compatible backend.

## Billing

### Payment history

The **Payment history** card on the org billing page lists your recent credit top-ups. Each row shows:

| Column | Details |

| - | - |
| Date | When the top-up was processed |
| Amount | Amount charged in USD |
| Status | `Succeeded`, `Pending`, or `Fa

iled` |
| Receipt | Link to the Stripe-hosted receipt (opens in a new tab) |

If a receipt isn't available yet the cell shows *
*Processing** (for pending charges) or **Not available** (for succeeded charges without a receipt link).\n\nTo add credits, click

**Top up** — either from the empty state when you have no history, or from the credit balance card above.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Fre
e plan organizations cannot purchase credits directly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog shows a messa
ge that only an organization owner can upgrade the plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog and opens

your organization's Plans settings so you can upgrade.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in the deskto
p app, checkout opens in your default system browser and the dialog closes automatically. Your credit balance updates in the app o

nce the purchase completes — no redirect back into the app is required.

### Spend budget

An owner or admin can cap what the
whole organization spends on MCPJam-billed\nwork — chat, evals, judges and computer time — for each billing period, from\n**Organi

zation → Budget**.

* Set the cap in dollars, and choose the percentages to be warned at. The
 default warns at 80%; reaching
the cap always notifies, whether or not you\n list it.\n* Warnings go to the organization's owners and admins in the notification

s
 bell, and to the owner by email.
* **When the budget is reached**, new chat turns, eval runs and computer starts
 are refu
sed for the whole organization. The refusal says the budget is\n reached and that an owner or admin can raise it — buying credits

does not
 clear it. Work already in flight finishes, and running computers keep going
 until they hibernate.
* A scheduled e
val that hits the budget pauses its schedule rather than\n retrying into the same cap every window; it resumes once you raise the

cap or
 the period rolls over.
* Runs that use **your own API keys** are never counted against the budget and
 never blocked
by it. Neither is the free daily allowance, which is not\n credits.\n* The window is your organization's own billing period: the
subscription cycle\n for team and enterprise plans, and the calendar month otherwise. Raising or\n lowering the cap mid-period

does not reset what has already been spent.

Any member can see the budget and how much of it is left; only owners and
admins c

an change it. Every change is recorded in the organization's audit log
with who made it and what it was before.

The same budge

t is readable and writable from the API at
`/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget`.

### Managing billing details
Organization owners on a paid plan see a **Manage billing** button on the billing page. Clicking it opens the Stripe portal where
you can update payment methods, download invoices, add tax IDs, and review billing details. Only organization owners can access th

is portal.

### Seat payment failures

When someone you invited to a paid-seat organization signs up and the automatic seat ch
arge fails or is cancelled, the org billing page shows a **Seat payment didn't go through** notice. As the org owner you can:\n\n*
Click **Retry payment** to reopen the charge and complete payment (including any 3DS challenge).\n* Click **Remove invite** to re
move the invite entirely if you no longer want to add that person.\n\nThe invited member's organization appears greyed out in thei

r sidebar until the seat is paid.
